clauses.clause: **No single follower is slower than the group.** While the group moves, every follower's median speed ≥ 0.95× the group median (tune); time the player stands waiting for one follower > 10 m behind ≤ 10 % of escort time (tune). PO: "let me stay with the crowd for suvivor."
clauses.note: Fresh current-main native L5 high complete seed3: follower28 in step/look has46 qualified walking samples, median3.9477449638m/s versus group4.4131743157m/s, ratio0.8945363771 (<0.95). L7 high complete seed2 departure follower66 additionally has27 samples and ratio0.9492090922. Majority-of-three diagnostics pass these followers, but a vote does not erase valid violations of the unchanged every-follower criterion. L1 stationary-far16.4561%/16.4696% values are upper bounds and are rejected as causal waiting FAIL evidence. Repro: npm run qa:accept -- --level L5 --skip-browser; inspect G-13 high/complete seed3 follower28 step/look; or node --import tsx/esm test-results/rr-b/g13-l5.mjs.
